mapper.select: SELECT * FROM parser_runtime_config WHERE config_key = #{configKey} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO parser_runtime_config (config_key, config_value, source, source_url, last_verified_at, last_refreshed_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{c.configKey}, #{c.configValue}, #{c.source}, #{c.sourceUrl}, #{c.lastVerifiedAt}, #{c.lastRefreshedAt}, #{c.createdAt}, #{c.updatedAt}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE parser_runtime_config SET config_value = #{c.configValue}, source = #{c.source}, source_url = #{c.sourceUrl}, last_verified_at = #{c.lastVerifiedAt}, last_refreshed_at = #{c.lastRefreshedAt}, updated_at = #{c.updatedAt} WHERE id = #{c.id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE parser_runtime_config SET deleted = id WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
